CompanyProfile.title: CompanyProfile
CompanyProfile.description: Stores general information about the business, including contact details, address, social media, vision, and mission.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CompanyProfile entity. (This entity is expected to be a singleton, so 'id' could be a fixed value like 'main').

companyName.description: The official name of the business.

profileDescription.description: A detailed description of the company profile, its background, and core business.

mainServicesDescription.description: A descriptive explanation of the primary services offered by the company.

address.description: The physical address of the business location.

phoneNumber.description: The primary contact phone number for the business, often used for WhatsApp communication.

email.description: The primary contact email address for the business.

operationalHours.description: A descriptive string representing the business's operating hours (e.g., 'Mon-Fri: 9 AM - 5 PM, Sat: 10 AM - 2 PM').

facebookLink.description: URL to the company's official Facebook profile.

instagramLink.description: URL to the company's official Instagram profile.

twitterLink.description: URL to the company's official Twitter (X) profile.

linkedinLink.description: URL to the company's official LinkedIn profile.

ServicePackage.title: ServicePackage
ServicePackage.description: Defines a specific service package offered by the business, detailing its features, pricing, and visual assets.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ServicePackage entity.

name.description: The human-readable name of the service package.

description.description: A concise and persuasive description of what the service package entails, potentially generated by AI.

imageUrl.description: URL to an illustrative image or icon representing the service package.

features.description: A list of key features or benefits included in this service package.

price.description: The clear and transparent price of the service package.

whatsappLink.description: A direct WhatsApp link specifically configured for inquiries about this service package, or a general contact link.

ServiceAdvantage.title: ServiceAdvantage
ServiceAdvantage.description: Represents a distinct advantage or unique selling proposition of the services provided by the business.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ServiceAdvantage entity.

title.description: The headline or short title describing the advantage (e.g., 'Teknisi Profesional').

description.description: A brief explanatory text further detailing the service advantage.

iconUrl.description: URL to an icon image that visually represents this advantage.

GalleryItem.title: GalleryItem
GalleryItem.description: An individual item within the project documentation gallery, showcasing visual evidence of past work.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GalleryItem entity.

title.description: A descriptive title or caption for the gallery item/photo.

description.description: An optional brief description providing context about the work shown in the image.

imageUrl.description: URL to the image file of the completed work.

category.description: An optional category tag for the gallery item, useful for filtering (e.g., 'Installation', 'Maintenance').

uploadDate.description: The date when the gallery item was uploaded or when the featured project was completed.

Testimonial.title: Testimonial
Testimonial.description: Captures customer reviews and star ratings to provide social proof for the services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Testimonial entity.

customerName.description: The name of the customer who provided the testimonial.

rating.description: The star rating given by the customer, typically on a scale of 1 to 5.

reviewText.description: The full text of the customer's review or feedback.

date.description: The date when the testimonial was submitted or published.

customerImageUrl.description: URL to the customer's profile picture or avatar, if available.

WebsiteSetting.title: WebsiteSetting
WebsiteSetting.description: Manages global website configurations and content for key sections like the Hero banner and main Call To Action.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WebsiteSetting entity. (This entity is expected to be a singleton, so 'id' could be a fixed value like 'main').

heroTitle.description: The prominent main title displayed in the Hero section.

heroSubtitle.description: A brief explanatory subtitle accompanying the Hero title.

heroCtaText.description: The text displayed on the Call To Action button within the Hero section (e.g., 'Pesan Sekarang').

heroCtaWhatsappLink.description: The WhatsApp link associated with the Hero section's Call To Action button.

mainCtaText.description: The text for the large, prominent Call To Action button found in a dedicated section (e.g., 'Ajakan untuk memesan sekarang').

mainCtaWhatsappLink.description: The WhatsApp link associated with the main, prominent Call To Action button.

definition.description: A collection used for Database Access Control (DBAC) to define administrative users. The existence of a document for a given 'userId' grants administrative privileges. This collection is for internal authorization checks and not directly tied to a specific content entity schema. It allows robust Authorization Independence for write operations.

firestore.reasoning: The recommended Firestore structure is designed to be highly secure, scalable, and debuggable, adhering strictly to the provided core design principles and mandates. Each primary entity (CompanyProfile, ServicePackage, ServiceAdvantage, GalleryItem, Testimonial, WebsiteSetting) is represented as a top-level collection. This approach ensures structural segregation, meaning all documents within a collection share a homogeneous security posture. Specifically, all content-related collections are publicly readable, facilitating straightforward 'list' operations (QAPs). Write access to these collections is restricted to administrative users. To achieve this, a dedicated 'roles_admin' collection is introduced, where the mere existence of a user's UID in this collection grants them administrative privileges. This design is critical for Authorization Independence: no security rule relies on 'get()' operations to check parent document attributes or complex data relationships for authorization. Instead, authorization for writes is an independent check against the 'roles_admin' collection, and reads are universally allowed for content. This simplicity minimizes the potential for security vulnerabilities and makes rules easy to understand and debug. For singleton entities like 'CompanyProfile' and 'WebsiteSetting', they reside in their respective collections and are typically accessed via a fixed document ID (e.g., 'main' or 'current'), maintaining consistency with the collection-based access pattern.
